name: dsh-pet-bridge
description: Bridge between DeepSeek Harness and a local desktop pet: session event push, per-session progress buckets, and 'user has actually seen it' notice acknowledgement.

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.check.json && tsc -p tsconfig.client.json && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --noEmit
scripts.test: npm run build:test && node --test --test-isolation=none --test-force-exit --test-timeout=60000 test-dist/tests/state.test.js test-dist/tests/protocol.test.js test-dist/tests/integration.test.js test-dist/tests/visibility.test.js test-dist/tests/decide.test.js test-dist/tests/client.test.js
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run smoke:bundle && npm test
